en.title: Fed holds rates steady despite elevated inflation
en.dek: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on October 28, 2026, as it awaited more data on inflation.
facts: Fed left benchmark interest rate unchanged
Decision made while awaiting additional inflation data
Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role
Fed is in an information-rich period before next meeting
Fed awaited accumulation of more information
body: According to AP News, the Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged on October 28, 2026. Reuters also reported the rate was held steady.
According to MS NOW, the decision was made as the central bank awaited additional data on inflation. Reuters said the Fed awaited the accumulation of more information.
According to Reuters, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said politics played no role in the rate decision. Der Spiegel reported the same statement.
The New York Times noted the Fed is in an 'information-rich period' before its next meeting.
AP News reported that inflation remains elevated. The Fed has been monitoring inflation closely.
According to Warsh, he was honored to lead the Fed. He emphasized the decision was based on data, not politics.
en.context: The Federal Reserve has been monitoring inflation data closely, according to AP News. The decision to hold rates steady follows a period of elevated inflation, as reported by Reuters.
